Inventory Costing Calculation Worksheet

The Inventory Costing Calculation Worksheet form configures parameters for cost analysis.

Set date ranges to calculate inventory costs using selected valuation methods.

Date

Specify the date for which the figures should be calculated.

Description

Enter a description for the report. This helps differentiate between various Inventory Costing Calculation Worksheet reports in the list.

Valuation method

Specify the valuation method as per which the figures should be calculated.
